description: This Java source file defines a Hibernate Envers RevisionListener that populates revision entity metadata such as the user who made the change and the timestamp when the revision was created, used within the OpenMRS project to track changes.

classes.name: OpenmrsRevisionEntityListener
classes.description: Implements Hibernate Envers RevisionListener to set revision metadata such as user and timestamp.

methods.name: newRevision
methods.description: Populates revision entity with user ID and timestamp based on the current authenticated user or daemon user.
